subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR define the public `sessions.activity`/`session.activity`/plugin-hook contract now, or should it be narrowed to a private UI/task-ledger implementation until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 is accepted?
rationale: The patch defines public Gateway and plugin SDK semantics, while related issues show unsettled attention, stale-run, child-rollup, and resync requirements that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Align Under Canonical Activity Contract
options.body: Require the PR to match maintainer-approved activity/attention semantics, repair the concrete text/scoping issues, and provide real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow To UI/Task Ledger Only
options.body: Remove or defer the public plugin hooks and broad activity API, using existing bounded task surfaces for an interim Control UI improvement.

options.title: Pause Behind The Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until the canonical activity contract and current-main conflict shape are settled.

recommendation.title: Align Under Canonical Activity Contract
recommendation.body: Require the PR to match maintainer-approved activity/attention semantics, repair the concrete text/scoping issues, and provide real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the assignee on the canonical Gateway activity issue and has recent Gateway/protocol history in the affected files.
